## Inclass exercise 07

Installing catchment R packages from github.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
remotes::install_github('uva-bi-sdad/catchment')
```
:::


Load sf, tidyverse, tmap acc and catchment packages.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
pacman::p_load(sf, tidyverse, tmap, accessibility, catchment)
```
:::

Import OD matrix


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ODMatrix <- read_csv("data/aspatial/OD_Matrix.csv", skip = 0)
```
:::


Tidy up the data


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
distmat <- ODMatrix %>%
  select(origin_id, destination_id, total_cost) %>%
  spread(destination_id, total_cost)%>%
  select(c(-c('origin_id')))


distmat_km <- as.matrix(distmat/1000)
```
:::


Use the code chunk below to create a new field called capacity in eldercare sf data frame and populate 100 in it.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
eldercare <- eldercare %>%
  select(fid) %>%
  mutate(capacity = 100)

hexagons <- hexagons %>%
  select(fid) %>%
  mutate(demand = 100) %>%
  rename(id = fid)
```
:::


Rename the column id


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ODMatrix_tidied <- ODMatrix %>%
  select(origin_id, destination_id, total_cost) %>%
  rename(from_id = origin_id,
         to_id = destination_id,
         dist = total_cost)
```
:::


## Computing Minimum Travel Distace to nearest oldercare


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
dist2closest <- cost_to_closest(
  travel_matrix = ODMatrix_tidied,
  land_use_data = hexagons,
  opportunity = "demand",
  travel_cost = "dist",
  n = 1,
  group_by = character(0),
  active = TRUE,
  fill_missing_ids = TRUE
)
```
:::


Append the computed closest distance values to *hexagons* sf data frame.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hex_acc <- hexagons %>%
  left_join(dist2closest) %>%
  rename(dist2closest = dist)
```
:::


Chotolepth map showing the distribution of closest values in *dist* field.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
mapex <- st_bbox(hex_acc)
tm_shape(hex_acc,
         bbox = mapex) + 
  tm_polygons(fill = "dist2closest", 
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                n = 10,
                values = "-brewer.blues")) +
  tm_shape(eldercare) +
  tm_dots(size = 0.3,
          fill = "red",
          col = "black") +
  tm_title("Accessibility to the closest eldercare") +
  tm_layout(frame = TRUE) +
  tm_compass(type="8star", size = 2) +
  tm_scalebar() +
  tm_grid(alpha = 0.2)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](In-class_Ex07_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-10-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::


## Converting ODMatrix data frame in a matrix


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
distmat <- ODMatrix %>%
  select(origin_id, destination_id, total_cost) %>%
  spread(destination_id, total_cost)%>%
  select(c(-c('origin_id')))

distmat_km <- as.matrix(distmat/1000)
```
:::


## Two-Step Floating Catchment Area


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
df_2sfca <- catchment_ratio(
  consumers = hexagons$demand,
  providers = eldercare$capacity,
  cost = distmat_km,
  max_cost = 5) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename("2SFCA" = ".")
```
:::


**Mapping 2SFCA**


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hex_2SFCA <- bind_cols(hexagons, df_2sfca) 
tm_shape(hex_2SFCA,
         bbox = mapex) + 
  tm_polygons(fill = "2SFCA", 
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                n = 10,
                values = "-brewer.blues")) +
  tm_shape(eldercare) +
  tm_dots(size = 0.3,
          fill = "red",
          col = "black") +
  tm_title("2SFCA Accessibility measures") +
  tm_layout(frame = TRUE) +
  tm_compass(type="8star", size = 2) +
  tm_scalebar() +
  tm_grid(alpha = 0.2)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](In-class_Ex07_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-13-1.png){width=768}
:::
:::


## Enhanced 2-Step Floating Catchment Area (E2SFCA)


::: {.cell}

  providers = eldercare$capacity,
